Sam_Sales: Passing over CardioCore - closed yesterday. Quick bullets:
- Industry: medical devices / cardiac monitoring. Data residency: EU-first, later US.
- Delivery mode: Dedicated (reserved pool) + private control plane.
- Must integrate with their event stream (FHIR preferred) and a legacy CSV export for older devices.
- Pilot load: ~80 QPS steady, spike to 300 QPS for batch ingest windows.
- Term: 12mo contract; renewal strong signal depends on pilot success.

Priya_CSM: Thanks Sam. Adding eng/support. Who at CardioCore will be our onboarding PM? Also need contract + data processing addendum (DPA).

Sam_Sales: Contact: lucas.morin@cardiocore.com (Onboarding PM). DPA link: https://drive.redwood/cardio/DPA_v2.pdf  Notes: they requested 10yr audit log retention and HSM KMS requirement for keys.

Priya_CSM: Noted. From CS side immediate items: kickoff call scheduling, collect IdP metadata, verify firewall and peering, confirm ingestion formats (FHIR v4 vs CSV), map success metrics for pilot.

Leo_Support: I can own the VPC peering & firewall side. Quick Q: private control plane means we still connect to our control plane endpoints over peered link or will they host inbound-only? Need clarity for runbook.

Sam_Sales: They want managed private control plane (our control plane in their VPC), not self-hosted.

Rina_Eng: For FHIR ingestion I'll need a sample FHIR bundle, auth type (Bearer? mTLS?), and whether they expect synchronous transforms. Also, for CSV batches, how big are files and frequency?

Sam_Sales: Lucas said FHIR is OAuth2 Bearer tokens for new devices; legacy CSVs are SFTP drops nightly (~200 files, ~50MB each).

Priya_CSM: Action owners (tentative):
- CS kickoff + onboarding tracker: Priya_CSM (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Collect IdP metadata + DPA signatures: Lucas + Priya_CSM (ETA: 72h)
- VPC peering + firewall runbook: Leo_Support (ETA: 48h)
- Eng work: FHIR parser + batch SFTP connector + capacity plan: Rina_Eng (ETA: 7 business days for first draft)

Leo_Support: Creating support ticket and adding checklist now. Ticket SUP-8910 created: https://support.redwood/t/SUP-8910. I'll attach port lists and sample iptables entries.

OpsBot: Calendar event created: "CardioCore Onboarding Kickoff" Thu 09:30 AM CET. Invites: Priya_CSM, Sam_Sales, Leo_Support, Rina_Eng, lucas.morin@cardiocore.com

Rina_Eng: Notes on capacity: with 80-300 QPS and nightly CSV bursts we likely need 2 dedicated replicas + autoscale policy to 6 for peak ingestion. I'll put rough cost delta in the eng ticket. Also proposing KV caching for repeated device prompts to save token cost.

Sam_Sales: Risk callout: they will delay payment milestone if pilot misses the SLA for ingestion throughput. Please flag any blockers early.

Priya_CSM: I'll define pilot success metrics: 1) stable ingest at 95th percentile traffic for 48h, 2) <1% ingest error rate, 3) time-to-first-query < 5min post-ingest. Will tracker these and share weekly with Sales.

Leo_Support: Next steps from my side: publish peering steps + ip list (48h), run preflight checklist in staging, share runbook link here when ready.

Rina_Eng: Creating ENG-1297 for FHIR + SFTP connectors. I'll include sample transform snippets. If CardioCore can provide a redacted FHIR sample today that would speed the spike.

Sam_Sales: Lucas said he can provide an anonymized FHIR bundle by EOD.

Priya_CSM: Great — I'll capture that in the tracker. Escalation plan: if any critical blocker persists >36h, I'll escalate to Ops lead and loop Sam.

Sam_Sales: Thanks all. I'll be available for exec touches if we need to push timeline. :slightly_smiling_face:

Priya_CSM: Closing summary: owners & ETAs reiterated. I'll post kickoff notes and the onboarding tracker link after the call. Ping here for reassignments. :raised_hands:
